newsitem.title: UK: Societe Generale's FIMAT expands in base metals.
newsitem.headline: Societe Generale's FIMAT expands in base metals.

text.p: FIMAT, a subsidiary of Societe Generale, announced on Monday a major push into the base metals markets with the establishment of FIMAT Metals, a specialist trading operation based in the UK.
FIMAT Metals will be staffed by 10 London-based members of the metals team at Brody White, acquired by FIMAT earlier this tear, FIMAT said in statement.
The new group also announced five new appointments.
Joining FIMAT Metals from Credit Lyonnais Rouse is Mark Slade, who will run FIMAT Metals operations on the London Metal Exchange (LME).

William Coleman also joins from Rouse, Stuart Penfold moves to FIMAT from the Pechiney Group, Hillary Waite moves from the options desk at Deutsche Bank's Sharps Pixley and Graeme Lawrence moves from Metdist Trading Ltd.

The statement said FIMAT Metals futures and options broking in contracts listed on the LME would complement Societe Generale's existing over-the-counter (OTC) base metals derivatives group based in Paris.
The two operations "will allow the Societe Generale group to offer a comprehensive service in base metals," FIMAT said.
"The establishment of FIMAT Metals is founded on FIMAT's belief that metals will be an important growth area in the commodities sector in the next five to 10 years," the statement said.
"FIMAT intends to build a major presence on the LME in the months ahead," it added.
